scope: Train-only alignment gate of A005 §4.3 on ViDoSeek train (799 queries, page unit). For each of the 66 static grid weights, compute train nDCG@10 and the A005 listwise profile loss (min over log τ in [log 1e-3, 0], golden-section, 60 iterations), then apply the A004 thresholds unchanged. No model is trained.

gate.G_B: nDCG@10 at the lowest-loss grid point >= grid max nDCG@10 - 0.01
gate.tie_rule: first minimum in grid order wins a loss tie (qpaf.m46.probe.gate)

outcome_rule.PASS: A005 may proceed to a separately authorized Stage 1 (ViMDoc inputs). It does not authorize Stage 1.
outcome_rule.REVISION_GATE_FAILED: A005 stops. No ViMDoc work, no training, no second loss (A005 §4.2). QPAF-v1 remains the reported method.

permissions.labels: ViDoSeek train qrels only, from the M4.2 development qrels filtered to the 799 train IDs

integrity_checks: The M4.2 bundle files match their manifest (qpaf.m42.active_primary.verify_files).
Development qrels hold no test query ID; only the 799 train IDs are kept.
All 66 grid nDCG@10 values replay the M4.6 probe within 1e-12; otherwise no record is written.
hardware: Local CPU only (Windows 11); float64; 1 thread; deterministic algorithms
stop_conditions: authorization not APPROVED or any source pin differs
grid nDCG@10 does not replay M4.6 within 1e-12
failure_rule: A failed or interrupted invocation is recorded as is and is not retried under this authorization.
claim_scope: A train-only diagnostic of whether the A005 loss orders static fusion weights like train nDCG@10. It is not a trained-model result and makes no validation, test or ViMDoc claim.
